def is_nested(s):
    depth = 0
    max_depth = 0
    for ch in s:
        if ch == '[':
            depth += 1
            if depth > max_depth:
                max_depth = depth
        elif ch == ']':
            depth -= 1
            if depth < 0:
                return False
    return depth == 0 and max_depth >= 2

# Tests
print(is_nested('[[]]'))            # True
print(is_nested('[]]]]]]][[[[[]'))  # False
print(is_nested('[][]'))            # False
print(is_nested('[]'))              # False
print(is_nested('[[][]]'))          # True
print(is_nested('[[]][['))          # False
